info.title: API.SH: TCGplayer
info.description: The TCGplayer API from API.SH: public TCGplayer data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
TCGplayer's search box suggestions for typed text: products (name, product id when unique, set, game, link, score), sets and games with match counts. Without `q`, give `game` for that game's trending searches.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tcgplayer-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Typed text.

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: With no q: the game (URL name, name or id) whose trending searches to list.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The newest tournament and community decks of a game, or its trending decks: id, name, link, format, player, event, event date and placing, colors, market price, source, date and image (trending decks also carry the low price and card count). Open one with /tcgplayer/v1/deck. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tcgplayer-decks

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Game: magic (default), pokemon, yugioh, lorcana, flesh-and-blood, one-piece, riftbound.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format, e.g. standard, modern, pioneer, legacy, commander (Pokemon: standard).

parameters.name: trending
parameters.description: 1 = the trending decks instead of the newest.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Decks per page (default 25, max 50).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Decks to skip (default 0).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tcgplayer-games

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every current listing of a TCGplayer product: price, shipping, quantity, condition, printing, language, the listing's photos and title for custom listings, and the seller (shop name, key, rating, sales, gold star, city, state, country), with facet counts. Page with `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tcgplayer-listings

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: TCGplayer product id (id of a search result, or the number in a tcgplayer.com/product/... link).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of id: a tcgplayer.com/product/... link.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: With latest=true: search words; the first search result is used (other search filters such as game also apply).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: run the search with q and the other search filters and use its first result.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Condition(s): near_mint, lightly_played, moderately_played, heavily_played, damaged, unopened.

parameters.name: printing

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language(s), e.g. english, japanese.

parameters.name: listing_type
parameters.description: standard (catalog listings) or custom (listings with the seller's own photos).

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description: Only this seller's listings (seller key).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order.

parameters.name: ship_to
parameters.description: Shipping country (two-letter code, default US).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Listings per page (max 50).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Result page (1 = first).

get.description:
Sold-price history of a TCGplayer product for each SKU (condition, printing, language): market price, quantity sold, transactions and the lowest and highest sale (with and without shipping) per day or week, oldest first, plus average daily sales and totals for the period.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tcgplayer-price-history

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: TCGplayer product id (id of a search result, or the number in a tcgplayer.com/product/... link).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of id: a tcgplayer.com/product/... link.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: With latest=true: search words; the first search result is used (other search filters such as game also apply).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: run the search with q and the other search filters and use its first result.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Period: month (daily points), quarter, semi-annual or annual (weekly points). Default quarter.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One TCGplayer product (card or sealed product): name, game, set, set code, number, rarity, type, market, median and lowest prices, listing and seller counts, release date, card text and every card attribute, image, each SKU (condition, printing, language) and the latest sales. Pass `id`, a `url`, or `q` with `latest=true` (first search result). Also `flavor_text`. With `sku_prices=1`, each SKU also has its market price, lowest and highest listed price, number of prices and when they were calculated.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tcgplayer-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: TCGplayer product id (id of a search result, or the number in a tcgplayer.com/product/... link).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of id: a tcgplayer.com/product/... link.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: With latest=true: search words; the first search result is used (other search filters such as game also apply).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: run the search with q and the other search filters and use its first result.

parameters.name: sku_prices
parameters.description: 1 to add market, lowest and highest price per SKU (condition, printing, language).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

The latest completed sales of a TCGplayer product: date, price, shipping, quantity, condition, printing, language and listing type. The site shows the 5 latest sales per filter to visitors; filter by condition or listing type for more, and see /tcgplayer/v1/price-history for daily sold prices and volumes.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tcgplayer-sales

get.description:
Search TCGplayer's trading-card marketplace (Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Lorcana, sports cards and 70+ other games): cards and sealed products with market, median and lowest prices, listing and seller counts, set, rarity, number and image, plus the cheapest current listings of each product and facet counts for every filter. Filters take the site's URL names (see facets in any response). Page with `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tcgplayer-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words (empty: everything matching the filters).

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Game / product line URL name, one or more comma-separated (see /tcgplayer/v1/games), e.g. pokemon, magic, yugioh, one-piece-card-game.

parameters.name: set
parameters.description: Set URL name(s), e.g. base-set, sv-scarlet-and-violet-151 (facets.setName).

parameters.name: product_type
parameters.description: Product type(s), e.g. cards, sealed-products (facets.productTypeName).

parameters.name: rarity
parameters.description: Rarity name(s), e.g. holo-rare, secret-rare (facets.rarityName).

parameters.name: card_type
parameters.description: Card type(s) (facets.cardType).

parameters.name: energy_type
parameters.description: Energy type(s) for Pokémon (facets.energyType).

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Only products with a listing in this condition: near_mint, lightly_played, moderately_played, heavily_played, damaged, unopened (comma-separated).

parameters.name: printing
parameters.description: Only products with a listing in this printing, e.g. normal, holofoil, reverse_holofoil, 1st_edition, foil.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Only products with a listing in this language, e.g. english, japanese.

parameters.name: seller_country
parameters.description: Only products listed by sellers in these countries (two-letter codes).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest market price (USD).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest market price (USD).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order.

parameters.name: ship_to
parameters.description: Shipping country for listing prices (two-letter code, default US).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (max 50, default 24).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Result page (1 = first).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Buyer feedback on a TCGplayer seller, newest first: order id, star rating, comment, date, buyer (masked as shown), and whether the order arrived when expected, was as described and the communication was good; plus the rating breakdown (count per star, positive share, the three yes/no ratings). Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tcgplayer-seller-feedback

parameters.description: Only feedback from the last N days (also applies to the breakdown).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Feedback per page (default 25, max 100).

get.description:
The sets of a TCGplayer game. Without `set`: every set of the game with id, name, URL name (for the `set` filter of /tcgplayer/v1/search), set code, release date, supplemental and active flags and link, newest first; `q` narrows by name or code. With `set`: that set's details plus its products (cards and sealed products with market, median and lowest prices, listing and seller counts, rarity, number, image and the cheapest listings) and facet counts, filtered, sorted and paged like /tcgplayer/v1/search (`q`, `product_type`, `rarity`, `condition`, `printing`, `price_min`, `price_max`, `sort`, `page`, `limit`); `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tcgplayer-set

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Game URL name, name or id (see /tcgplayer/v1/games), e.g. pokemon, magic, yugioh, one-piece-card-game.

parameters.name: set
parameters.description: A set's URL name, id, name or code, e.g. base-set, 604, Base Set or BS; returns that set with its products.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Without `set`: only sets whose name or code contains this. With `set`: search words within the set's products.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Without `set`: newest (default), oldest or name. With `set`: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, name_asc or name_desc.

parameters.name: include_inactive
parameters.description: true also lists sets the site marks inactive.

parameters.name: product_type
parameters.description: With `set`: product type(s), e.g. cards, sealed-products.

parameters.name: rarity
parameters.description: With `set`: rarity name(s), e.g. holo-rare.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: With `set`: only products with a listing in this condition, e.g. near-mint, lightly-played.

parameters.name: printing
parameters.description: With `set`: only products with a listing in this printing, e.g. holofoil, 1st-edition-holofoil.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: With `set`: lowest market price in USD.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: With `set`: highest market price in USD.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: With `set`: page number (default 1).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: With `set`: products per page (1-50, default 24).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
